messages:
sam: Heads up — us-west2 GPU pool showing weird fragmentation after the reserve bump. Lots of 0.5–1 GPU tiny pods stranded on large nodes, warm-pools nearly full. Noticed an ~8% cost spike yesterday. Anyone else seeing this?
priya: Yep saw an alert this morning. Can you grab the compactness metric and a list of affected deployments?
mike: Quick PromQL I ran:```sum by(node, gpu_request) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="nvidia.com/gpu"}) / on(node) group_left() kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="nvidia.com/gpu"}```shows bunch of low-request pods spread across nodes.
jess: We should consider a targeted footprint-scrub: migrate non-prod tiny pods into the spot-compact pool and consolidate full-GPU jobs onto bigger slots. If we flip `scheduler.rebalance.compactness=high` for a canary AZ it should defragment without full drain.
sam: Risk is evictions + NIC egress spikes during migration. We saw a few pod restarts tied to network saturation last week. Can we throttle migration concurrency?
priya: Yes — add a migration-window + concurrency cap. Off-peak and per-AZ rate limit. Also we need owners list for tiny pods so we don't migrate sensitive QA runs.
mike: I'll dump a list. PromQL for affected deployments:```topk(200, sum by(namespace, deployment) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="nvidia.com/gpu"} * on(node) group_left() (1)))```will give the suspects. Pushing gist now.
infra-bot: Alert: us-west2 GPU fragmentation >0.45 since 2026-03-20T03:12:00Z — warmpool saturation 87% — auto-scale checks passed.
jess: For the canary, plan: 1) pick one AZ (us-west2-b), 2) set `rebalance.compactness=high` + `migration.max_concurrent=10`, 3) migrate only `env!=prod && gpu_request<=1`, 4) observe latency/errors for 60m, rollback if >1% error delta.
sam: Sounds good. Who runs the job?
priya: I can coordinate the canary and notify owners. Mike, can you generate owner mapping and a dry-run plan?
mike: On it. Dry-run tool:```./devtools/gpu-scrub --region us-west2 --az us-west2-b --dry-run --filter 'env!=prod && gpu<=1'```returns plan with ~420 pods to move (dry-run). Posting link to gist of plan. :link: https://gist.internal/xyz123
sam: Nice. Add throttling to avoid >50MB/s egress per node (we saw NIC saturation at ~70MB/s).
jess: We'll add `network.throttle=50mbps` to the scrub job. Also set `kube_eviction_threshold=0.9` for the canary nodes to avoid cascading evicts.
deploy-bot: Started job gpu-scrub-canary-176821 at 2026-03-20T04:20:00Z — 0/420 migrated (dry-run false). Track at /jobs/176821
infra-bot: Note: migrating pods will trigger controller resyncs; might spike API server QPS — watch apiserver latency.
priya: We'll run the canary 00:30–01:30 UTC window. I'll post updates here. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
sam: Thanks — priya/mike please post results by EOD. If error delta >1% or node egress >65MB/s we stop and rollback.
